annotations.title: What lands on a bounty program

description:
At the START of an engagement on a bug-bounty PROGRAM, get a grounded prior over what bug
classes have historically LANDED there — to decide what to look at first and what to skip.

Built from real HackerOne disclosed reports: the class distribution for this program, each with
LIFT over the global base-rate, sample size, and cited example reports; plus `lands_rarely` — the
classes that land broadly across programs but almost never here (where NOT to spend the first hour).

DESCRIPTIVE, not predictive: it reports what *landed*, never claims what you *will* find. It's a
disclosure-selected sample, HackerOne-only (~379 programs with public disclosures), models bug-class
not payout, and withholds a prior when the program has too few reports (an anecdote isn't a
distribution). Pass a program handle or name, e.g. "gitlab", "shopify". Complements
find_attack_approaches (mechanism transfer) and hunt_plan (CVE dig-order) — this is the minute-zero
"where to start" prior an agent has no tacit target knowledge to form on its own.
name: program_outcome_prior
